title: Three-foot object with buttons lying on Mars

tellings.quote: that's 3 feet long and that big around that's and it's got buttons on it

plain: An object about three feet long, with buttons on it, is lying on the surface of Mars, according to Joe McMoneagle, a man who took part in psychic spying work. McMoneagle says he saw it himself on photo negatives from the Mars mapping done by JPL, NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which builds and runs its robot space probes. If true, it would mean something made by someone was left on Mars.
